questions.q: What does passing DP-750 actually certify?
options: The Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate credential
General Python programming ability
Microsoft Fabric administration
Kubernetes cluster management
questions.explain: DP-750, 'Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks,' is Microsoft's associate-level exam for that specific credential.

questions.q: Per Microsoft's own published study guide, which two domains carry the highest combined exam weight?
options: Prepare and process data (30-35%) and Deploy and maintain data pipelines and workloads (30-35%)
Set up and configure an environment (15-20%) and Secure and govern Unity Catalog objects (15-20%)
All four domains are weighted exactly equally at 25% each
Only one domain exists, weighted at 100%
questions.explain: Together, preparing/processing data and deploying/maintaining pipelines make up 60-70% of the exam — more than the other two domains combined.

questions.q: What scaled score does Microsoft require to pass DP-750?
options: 700 or greater, on a 1-1000 scale
A raw 90% of all questions answered correctly
50 out of 100 questions correct
Microsoft does not publish a passing score
questions.explain: Microsoft's official scoring page confirms a scaled score of 700 or greater is required, on the standard 1-1000 scale used across Microsoft certifications.

questions.q: Which chapters of this course map most directly onto the 'Prepare and process data' domain?
options: Chapter 2 (Auto Loader & Ingestion) and Chapter 3 (Lakeflow & Declarative Pipelines)
Chapter 6 (Advanced Security & Governance) only
Chapter 1 (Unity Catalog Deep Dive) only
None of this course's chapters relate to this domain
questions.explain: Auto Loader ingestion and Lakeflow transformation/data-quality work are exactly what this domain tests.

questions.q: According to this lesson, why should you re-check Microsoft's official DP-750 study guide before scheduling the real exam, rather than relying only on this lesson's percentages?
options: Microsoft revises exam skill lists and domain weights on its own schedule, and they can shift between when a course is recorded and when you sit for the exam
This lesson's percentages are entirely fabricated and have no real source
DP-750 has been fully retired and no longer exists
Domain weights never change once published, so re-checking is unnecessary
questions.explain: The percentages here were verified against Microsoft's current study guide at the time this lesson was written, but Microsoft can and does revise these periodically.

questions.q: Does Microsoft's public DP-750 study guide publish an exact fixed question count and duration?
options: No — both can vary by exam form, so the current exam registration page should be checked directly
Yes — exactly 60 questions in 120 minutes, guaranteed for every candidate
Yes — exactly 40 questions in 90 minutes, guaranteed for every candidate
The exam has no time limit at all
questions.explain: Being honest about what's actually published: Microsoft's public study guide does not fix an exact question count or duration.

questions.q: Why does this chapter's Lesson 31 review rather than teach new material?
options: Every earlier chapter already taught the content this exam tests — this lesson organizes it the way Microsoft organizes the exam instead
Because the course ran out of new topics to cover
Because DP-750 tests content unrelated to anything in this course
Because this lesson replaces all six earlier chapters
questions.explain: Chapters 1-6 already built every skill DP-750 tests; this chapter reorganizes and drills it exam-style.
